headline: COPD linked to higher risk of heart failure and heart attack in meta-analysis of 140 studies
dek: Prof Chris P Gale said a meta-analysis of 140 case-control studies found COPD was associated with higher risks of heart failure, heart attack, chronic kidney disease and death.
body:
Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) was associated with a higher risk of heart failure, heart attack, chronic kidney disease and death, according to a meta-analysis described by Prof Chris P Gale on X.

Gale, Professor of Cardiovascular Medicine and an honorary consultant cardiologist, wrote that the analysis covered 140 case-control studies including 30 million people. His post tagged the journal eClinicalMed.

According to the post, the risk ratio (RR) for heart failure in people with COPD was 2.33 (95% CI 1.78 to 3.06). For heart attack, the RR was 1.47. Gale also listed chronic kidney disease and death among the outcomes associated with COPD.

The post links to the full paper and includes an image.
